lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ninety days ago, I couldn't finish a sentence. Tonight, I'm gonna finish this pitch.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Macal Empire isn't just an idea. It's a bridge — between where I'm from and where we're all going.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Mr. Macal — if we fund you, what happens to everything else you're holding?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Let me buy myself a second here... because that question? That's the whole reason I'm standing here.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا جَمَاعَة! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاكُمْ فِي يَلَّا فْلُوَنْت... وَاللَّيْلَة، مَكَّال واقِف قُدَّام غُرْفَة كَامِلَة، وَبِيعْمِل أَهَمّ بِيتْش فِي حَيَاتُه!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: الرِّجَّال لَازِم يِكْسَب الغُرْفَة... وَبِنَفْس الوَقْت، نُور هَتْقُولُه سِرّ كَبِير.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خَلِّيكُمْ مَعَايَا، وَرَكِّزُوا عَلَى تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات: Let me buy myself a second... عَشَان تِكْسَب وَقْت، ثُمَّ Here's what I'd do... لَمَّا تِرَدّ عَلَى سُؤَال، وَكَمَان That's the whole reason I'm standing here!
lines.direction: clear, teaching emphasis on each English phrase

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا... نِسْمَع مَكَّال!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: So that's the model. Sixteen weeks, forty riders, one neighborhood at a time. And every delivery teaches one kid one new word.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Impressive. But we've seen delivery apps before. What makes yours different?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Let me buy myself a second here... because this is the part that matters.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: The difference isn't the app. It's the people. Every rider is a student. Every student becomes a teacher. That's the loop nobody else can copy.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: And if the funding runs out in six months?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Here's what I'd do. We shrink to one district, cut the fleet, and run on the community model alone. We've done it before — with less.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Bold numbers, Macal. But can you really scale that fast in Dubai?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I live here since two years, Tarek. I know these streets better than my own. If I can scale trust in Karama, I can scale it anywhere.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: You're not answering like a founder. You're answering like someone who's already lived this.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Because that's the whole reason I'm standing here. Not the money. The proof — that a kid from Cairo can build something this city actually needs.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Macal. We'll be in touch this week.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal. Can we talk for a minute? Outside.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sure. You okay? You've been watching me like you've got something heavy to say.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: I do. I recommended you for this fellowship, Macal. Months ago. Nobody knows.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait — you did what? Why didn't you tell me?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Because it wasn't mine to give. And because I might be leaving Dubai next month.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا جَمَاعَة، نْفَكِّكْ مَعَ بَعْض... أَوَّلًا، "Let me buy myself a second"... يَعْنِي اِدِّينِي لَحْظَة أَفَكَّر، وَمَشْ هَرَب، لَأ، دَه ذَكَاء! تِقُولْهَا لَمَّا مَحْتَاج تِجَمَّع أَفْكَارَك، زَي: Let me buy myself a second here — I want to get this right. ثَانِيًا، "Here's what I'd do"... دِي لَمَّا تِرَدّ عَلَى سُؤَال صَعْب، بِطَرِيقَة هَادْيَة وَوَاثْقَة. وَثَالِثًا، "That's the whole reason I'm standing here"... يَعْنِي دَه السَّبَب الحَقِيقِي إِنِّي وَاقِف هِنَا. تِقُولْهَا لَمَّا تِرْبَط كَلَامَك بِقَلْبَك، وَتَخْلِي النَّاس تِحِسْ بِيك.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَس خُدْ بَالَك مِن غَلْطَة شَائِعَة... مَكَّال قَال: "I live here since two years"... وَدِي تَرْجَمَة حَرْفِيَّة مِن العَرَبِي "أَنَا عَايِش هِنَا مِن سَنَتَيْن". الإِنْجِلِيزِي مَايْقُولْهَاش كِدَه! الصَّح: "I've lived here for two years"... أَو "I've been living here for two years".

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي... Accent Lab! النَّهَارْدَه عَن Contrastive stress... يَعْنِي حُط الضَّغْط عَلَى الكَلِمَة الِّي عَايِز تِوَضَّحْهَا. زَي: "I said BLUE, not GREEN"... الضَّغْط بِيوَدِّي المَعْنَى. مِن الحِوَار: "The difference isn't the app... it's the PEOPLE"... إِسْمَع الفَرْق. مُش APP... PEOPLE. كَرَّرْهَا مَعَايَا: it's the PEOPLE... PEOPLE!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait. You recommended me? Nour, I've been chasing this thing for months. I thought I was invisible.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You weren't invisible. You just never looked up. And listen — I've been living here for three years, Macal. This place is home now. So if I leave, it won't be because I want to.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hold on. Let me buy myself a second here. You're telling me the person who opened this door might just walk out of it? That's a lot to carry in one night.
lines.direction: steady, buying time, reusing the phrase naturally

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: I know. But you didn't need me in that room tonight. You owned it. That's the whole reason I'm standing here telling you the truth.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Mr. Macal — one moment. The panel wants to see you again at nine tomorrow. We're announcing the fellowship results right after.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nine tomorrow. Okay. I'll be there. And Nour — whatever happens with Chicago, you're gonna see this through with me. Right?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: We'll see. Results first. Then we talk about Chicago.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا جَمَاعَة، نِلَخَّص بِسُرْعَة... اتْكَلَّمْنَا عَنْ Let me buy myself a second... يَعْنِي اِدِّينِي لَحْظَة أَفَكَّر. وَعَنْ Here's what I'd do... لَمَّا تِرَدّ بِثِقَة. وَعَنْ That's the whole reason I'm standing here... لَمَّا تِرْبَط كَلَامَك بِقَلْبَك.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَفَاكِر... مُش I live here since two years، لَأ. الصَّح: I've lived here for two years. وَالـ Contrastive stress... الضَّغْط بِيوَدِّي المَعْنَى: it's the PEOPLE... مُش APP!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب... Phrase of the Episode النَّهَارْدَه هِيَ... Let me buy myself a second... عَجِبَاك؟ دِي الِّي هِنْسَجِّلْهَا مَعَ بَعْض!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: عَايِز مِنَّك حَاجَة وَاحْدَة... سَجِّل نُوتَة صَوْت صَغِيرَة، قُول فِيهَا Let me buy myself a second... وَحُط الضَّغْط عَلَى buy... وَابْعَتَهَا لـ Empire English Community عَلَى تِلِيجْرَام. إِحْنَا فِي اسْتِنَاك، وَنِسْمَع لَكِنْتَك وَنِشَجِّعَك!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا... مِسْتَنِّيك، وَمَتْخَافِش مِن الغَلَط. إِحْنَا عَايِلَة وَاحْدَة!

phrase_of_episode.en: Let me buy myself a second
